        <;>

              have h₅ : x ≥ -17 := by linarith
              interval_cases x <;> norm_num <;> omega
            exact h₃
          })
        <;>
        omega
      have h₂ : ((2 * x + 4 * x) / 2) / 3 = x := by
        rw [h₁]
        <;>
        (try omega) <;>
        (try

            have h₃ : x ≤ 17 := by linarith
            have h₄ : x ≥ -17 := by linarith
            interval_cases x <;> norm_num <;> omega

        <;>

        <;>

            <;>

          })
        <;>

      simp_all [h₁, h₂, h₃]
      <;>

          <;>

          <;>
          omega

      have h₁ : x + 2 * x = 3 * x := by ring
      have h₂ : (x + 2 * x) / 3 = x := by
        have h₃ : x ≥ 18 := by linarith
        have h₄ : (x + 2 * x) / 3 = x := by
          have h₅ : x ≥ 18 := by linarith
          have h₆ : (x + 2 * x) / 3 = x := by
            -- Prove that (x + 2 * x) / 3 = x when x ≥ 18

      have h₃ : ((x + 2 * x) / 3) * 3 = x + 2 * x := by
